milestone: Operational Hardening / Portable KB / MultiQuery Evaluation Readiness
base_runtime: current uploaded v6.4.92 project; includes the pending v6.4.93 ambiguity/follow-up hardening

fixes.kb_update_missing_unstructured: unstructured is lazy/optional for files with native DocuBot loaders; parser failures propagate safely and transactional rebuild preserves the previous index
fixes.kb_update_preflight: checks parser dependencies, local Ollama reachability, and qwen3-embedding:8b before a rebuild starts
fixes.kb_update_ui_failure: no raw Streamlit traceback for normal update failure; concise message plus logs/kb_update diagnostics
fixes.portable_manifest: source identity is relative to data/technical_documents so moving/copying the project does not look like delete+add of every source
fixes.portable_source_cards: stored absolute source paths are remapped to the current technical_documents installation when possible
fixes.single_source_root: data/technical_documents is the only active runtime source root; obsolete data/all_documents PDF server is removed from startup
fixes.connection_resilience: short Ollama connect timeout for embeddings, one retry for quick connection-reset/refused cases, no automatic retry of long timeouts, friendly UI error text
fixes.server_update_report: Path objects are serialized safely in server KB update reports
fixes.kb_health_failure_path: VECTOR_BACKEND diagnostic reference is imported correctly
fixes.v6_4_93_semantics: generic compiler switch/flag is ambiguity-aware and self-contained permission questions do not borrow stale follow-up state
fixes.multi_query: centralized experimental setting/prompt/parser is included but production remains OFF pending RAGAS/Golden precision-recall A/B
